user.title: Eufy Cameras
user.description: Connect to a running ha-eufy-sdk-bridge (Mega / v6 cloud). The bridge handles Eufy login and 2FA; this integration imports doorbell (T82xx) and indoor (T84xx) cameras.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Mega SDK bridge. Check host, port, that the bridge is running, and that auth is ok (2FA/captcha completed).

abort.already_configured: This Mega SDK bridge is already configured.
